title: Guard allocation-import in/out words and signed-size conversion
goal: Produce a separately verified selected-kernel derivative for the actual unsafe pointer and signed-minimum behavior retained by MW3-046, without modifying existing sources/SDKs, shared argument-thunk APIs or the guest startup allowlist.
acceptance: Bind the exact selected SDK/XMA parent composition, mapped-pointer thunk, checked guest-memory access, heap policies and retained actual-library baseline failures before editing; preserve BSD/Xenia notices and distinguish selected-fork policy from unavailable retail-console parity

Validate both allocation/free in/out words for null, complete nonwrapping mapped readable/writable range and required alignment before any typed dereference, trace read or memory mutation; preserve valid physical aliases and reject overlapping output words diagnostically

Compute the magnitude of negative 32-bit allocation sizes without signed-minimum negation overflow; retain ordinary reserve/commit/decommit/release, endian outputs, failure immutability, neighbouring bytes and allocation/resource recovery

Build private native Windows/Linux and supported participating-kernel ASan/UBSan profiles from isolated exact derived sources, replacing only the declared kernel library in a verified parent package while leaving original SDK/source/build outputs unchanged

Use original actual-kernel callbacks, exact loaded-module identities and meaningful wrong-result/incomplete/deadline controls; supply a strict preparation verifier, synthetic mutation/isolation guards and a source-only public report before MW3-046 can complete adoption
validation: Retain matched baseline failures and run repeated repaired positive/negative import cases with exact source/compiler/config/binary/package/receipt/log identities; distinguish host-only and participating-kernel sanitizer coverage and unsupported Windows core instrumentation
Reject changed source, patch, parent, compiler, library/package and preparation receipts and overlapping outputs; verify all unaffected package files and original parent sources remain byte-identical

Run python tools/check.py and relevant supported platform/sanitizer checks; record exact commands, skips, provenance review, self-review and unresolved behavior; no title execution, new startup service, retail ABI certification or performance claim
size: bounded isolated allocation/free entry repair and verified SDK profile; MW3-046 remains the separate full import-ABI consumer
evidence: Exact opt-in selected-kernel derivative validates both allocation/free in/out words before typed access or trace reads, rejects physical alias overlap, preserves valid aliases and computes signed-size magnitude with unsigned subtraction; global thunks and startup allowlist unchanged

Three isolated verified Windows/Linux native and participating-kernel Linux ASan/UBSan preparations replace only rexkernel in exact XMA parent packages; original source/package identities retained and checked

615 actual-kernel processes across five profiles and three repetitions: 570 ordinary passes and 45 correctly rejected result/incomplete/deadline controls; 615 distinct nonces, all loaded kernels/source/compiler/binary/compile-command/log identities audited; matched 205-process failing baseline retained
36 real artifact/receipt mutation controls and eight public synthetic preparation/output-isolation guards PASS; changed files restored and original parent identities reverified

Windows Release and Linux Release ASan/UBSan public checks PASS: 313 Python tests each with eight/two explicit skips, parser CTest1/1 each; 66-task DAG and heuristic/manual provenance/diff review pass
